findings.highlight: tearing off the chains of her anchor
findings.evidenceJa: 自ら防波堤を決壊させる方向へ波を追い込んだ
findings.explanation: Haruki calls himself the breakwater meant to protect Kazusa, then says he drove the waves toward making that very breakwater collapse. The translation replaces the structure with an anchor and invents chains being torn off, losing his image of actively worsening the pressure he was meant to block.
findings.japanese:
それどころか、かずさの感情を強く刺激して、
自ら防波堤を決壊させる方向へ波を追い込んだ。
findings.todokanai: If anything, I fiercely provoked Kazusa's feelings. I was the one responsible for tearing off the chains of her anchor.

findings.highlight: a crime of conscience
findings.evidenceJa: そこで謝るのも確信犯よね
findings.explanation: Youko calls Haruki a 確信犯: he apologizes while knowingly persisting and accepting that the apology will not make him withdraw. 'Crime of conscience' is not the idiom and obscures her criticism of deliberate, unrepentant conduct.
findings.japanese:
「…そこで謝るのも確信犯よね。
わたしが巻き込んだことに文句一つ言わずに」
findings.todokanai: "…Apologizing there is a crime of conscience too. Never once complaining about how I dragged you into this mess."

findings.highlight: I'll administer the same medicine
findings.evidenceJa: 前回と同じ薬を投与しといて。で、目覚めたら僕に直接連絡して
findings.explanation: The doctor instructs another medical worker to administer the same medicine as last time and contact him when Youko wakes. The translation makes him the person who will administer it, contradicting the following request to contact him.
findings.japanese:
「…とりあえず、前回と同じ薬を投与しといて。
で、目覚めたら僕に直接連絡して」
findings.todokanai: "…I'll administer the same medicine as last time for now. Contact me directly once she wakes up."

findings.highlight: You weren't even like this when you were a baby
findings.evidenceJa: あなたが赤ん坊の時だって、こんなことしなかったわよ
findings.explanation: Youko says that even when Kazusa was a baby, she herself never soothed and embraced her like this. The translation says baby Kazusa did not behave like this, reversing the caregiver and destroying Youko's next-line admission that this neglect helped make Kazusa who she is.
findings.japanese:
「まったく…
あなたが赤ん坊の時だって、
こんなことしなかったわよ？」
findings.todokanai: "Jeez… You weren't even like this when you were a baby, you know?"

findings.highlight: deadlines for bachelor's and master's theses
findings.evidenceJa: 卒論発表や修論発表も間近に迫っている
findings.explanation: What is approaching is the undergraduate- and master's-thesis presentation period, explaining activity in the university buildings at night. The translation changes public presentations into manuscript deadlines.
findings.japanese:
それでも、学部棟の窓からいくつか明かりが漏れていて、
試験だけでなく、卒論発表や修論発表も
間近に迫っていることを伺わせる。
findings.todokanai: Despite that, there are still some illuminated windows in the school buildings. They indicate that more than just exams are closing in, but also the deadlines for bachelor's and master's theses.

findings.highlight: once she comes out to the world. That's why I can't knock on her door
findings.evidenceJa: 天照大神の出てきた後の世界を自分の中にイメージできていない。だから今、その扉の前で踊る訳には行かない
findings.explanation: Haruki explicitly continues the Heavenly Rock Cave myth: he cannot imagine the world after Amaterasu emerges, so he cannot yet dance before the cave door to entice her out. The translation removes Amaterasu and replaces ritual dance with knocking, erasing the source's sustained mythic analogy.
findings.japanese:
だって俺はまだ、天照大神の出てきた後の世界を
自分の中にイメージできていない。
だから今、その扉の前で踊る訳には行かない。
findings.todokanai: Because I still don't know what will happen once she comes out to the world. That's why I can't knock on her door just yet.

findings.highlight: it might be accurate to call it her final goal as a pianist
findings.evidenceJa: その日がピアニストとしての最終到達点となっても構わないほどに
findings.explanation: Haruki imagines Kazusa pursued the day she surpassed Youko so exclusively that she might not mind even if it became her final destination as a pianist. The translation merely classifies the goal as possibly final, losing her inferred willingness to let everything culminate there.
findings.japanese:
もしかしたら、その日がピアニストとしての
最終到達点となっても構わないほどに、
そこだけ目指してたんだと思う。
findings.todokanai: Her aim was so focused on that specific goal that it might be accurate to call it her final goal as a pianist.

findings.highlight: begged her to stay after she graduated
findings.evidenceJa: 大学に進学してからも泣きつかれるままバイトを続け
findings.explanation: Koharu continued the job after advancing to university because the restaurant pleaded with her. The translation has her continue only after graduating, moving the episode several years and removing the high-school-to-university transition.
findings.japanese:
結局、大学に進学してからも泣きつかれるまま
バイトを続け、いつの間にやら数十人の常連を生み出す
看板娘になっていたっけ。
findings.todokanai: Eventually, the other employees begged her to stay after she graduated, which she did. And soon after, she became the poster girl for the restaurant, attracting dozens of repeat customers.

findings.highlight: I don't want to know someone I can't understand
findings.evidenceJa: 自分にとって、わからない人でいて欲しくないから
findings.explanation: Koharu says she does not want Haruki to remain someone she cannot understand, which is why she wants to know him. The translation says she does not want to know such a person, reversing the desire that motivates her intervention.
findings.japanese:
『先輩のことを知るためです。
自分にとって、わからない人でいて欲しくないから』
findings.todokanai: "Because I want to know more about you. I don't want to know someone I can't understand."

findings.highlight: I feel bothered when you act like that
findings.evidenceJa: そういう態度は改めてもらわないと困ります
findings.explanation: Koharu tells Haruki that if he is going to remain near her, she needs him to correct that attitude. The translation turns a characteristic demand that he change into a statement of personal annoyance.
findings.japanese:
『わたしの近くにいる以上、
そういう態度は改めてもらわないと困ります』
findings.todokanai: "Well, I feel bothered when you act like that around me."

findings.highlight: effort, independent of her talent and painful fantasies
findings.evidenceJa: その才能と、夢想混じりの苦しみを伴わない努力だけで上がってきた
findings.explanation: Haruki says Kazusa rose on her talent and effort mixed with fantasy that did not involve suffering. The translation makes the effort independent of her talent and attaches pain to the fantasies, reversing both components of his critical characterization.
findings.japanese:
しかも、そんな普通じゃない現実の中ですら、その才能と、
夢想混じりの苦しみを伴わない努力だけで上がってきた、
正真正銘、純粋培養の天才なんだから。
findings.todokanai: Not only that, even in the unnatural reality she lives in, she still is a true genius who managed to improve through effort, independent of her talent and painful fantasies.

findings.highlight: will depart shortly
findings.evidenceJa: まもなく、一番線御宿行きが参ります
findings.explanation: The Onjuku-bound train is about to arrive at platform one. The translation announces that it will depart, changing the stage of the station sequence before the later platform-two departure.
findings.japanese:
「まもなく、一番線御宿行きが参ります。
白線の内側までお下がりください」
findings.todokanai: "The train on Line 1 toward Onjuku will depart shortly. Please stay within the white lines."

findings.highlight: All because of a nobody like me.
findings.evidenceJa: 誰でもない、俺のせいで
findings.explanation: 誰でもない means nobody else: Haruki assigns himself sole responsibility for Kazusa's collapse. The translation misreads it as Haruki calling himself an insignificant nobody, losing the all-exclusive causal claim.
findings.japanese:
あいつは、積み上げてきたものを全て失って、
根元からぽきりと折れてしまったんだから。
…誰でもない、俺のせいで。
findings.todokanai: She has broken down at her very foundation, losing everything she built up… All because of a nobody like me.

findings.highlight: feign strength despite her weak heart
findings.evidenceJa: 弱い心のまま、強い力を振り回し
findings.explanation: Haruki imagines Kazusa retaining a weak heart while wielding her genuinely great power recklessly enough to destroy an ordinary world. The translation says she only pretends to be strong, removing the dangerous mismatch between real ability and emotional weakness.
findings.japanese:
そうして、周囲の期待や家族の思いを全て捨て去り、
弱い心のまま、強い力を振り回し、
普通の世界を壊してしまうという未来は…
findings.todokanai: Will she turn her back on the expectations her surroundings have for her, as well as the feelings of her family? Will she feign strength despite her weak heart and approach a future where any semblance of a normal world would be ruined?

findings.highlight: the same as determining her life for her
findings.evidenceJa: そいつ自身の人生を決断するってことでも
findings.explanation: If someone commands Kazusa's choice, that person must also decide his or her own life. The translation repeats deciding Kazusa's life, losing the reciprocal stake that leads Haruki to become that someone.
findings.japanese:
でもそれって、
そいつ自身の人生を決断するってことでも…
あるんじゃないのか？
findings.todokanai: But wouldn't that be the same as determining her life for her…?

findings.highlight: pretty naive
findings.evidenceJa: 北原って結構ナイーブだよな。傷つきやすくて
findings.explanation: Mari calls Haruki emotionally sensitive or delicate, immediately glossed as easily hurt. Rendering ナイーブ as English 'naive' falsely characterizes him as inexperienced or gullible.
findings.japanese:
『北原って結構ナイーブだよな。
傷つきやすくて、自分で自分を責めてばかりで』
findings.todokanai: "You're pretty naive, aren't you, Kitahara? You're quite fragile, and you always seem to only put the blame on yourself."

findings.highlight: nobody you could ask for forgiveness afterward
findings.evidenceJa: 叱った後、許してくれないから
findings.explanation: Mari asks whether Haruki sinks further because no one scolds him and then forgives him. The translation instead says he lacks someone from whom he can request forgiveness, reversing who performs the absolution and weakening her refusal in the next line.
findings.japanese:
『だから余計落ち込むのか？
誰も、自分を叱ってくれないから。
…叱った後、許してくれないから』
findings.todokanai: "Is that why you got so depressed? Because there was nobody to reprimand you for it? Because there was nobody you could ask for forgiveness afterward…?"

findings.highlight: I'm thoroughly connected to every corner of it
findings.evidenceJa: その世界の隅々まで繋がろうと手を伸ばしてる
findings.explanation: Haruki is reaching outward, trying to connect with every corner of his small social world. The translation declares him already thoroughly connected, turning ongoing effort and openness into completed social mastery.
findings.japanese:
かずさのそれとは似ても似つかない小さな世界だけど、
その世界の隅々まで繋がろうと手を伸ばしてる。
findings.todokanai: My world may be a small one that bears no resemblance to Kazusa's world, but I'm thoroughly connected to every corner of it.

findings.highlight: pass the night walking around in circles
findings.evidenceJa: いつまでも堂々巡りを繰り返し、今日という日をやり過ごそうとしていた
findings.explanation: Haruki was repeating the same circular reasoning and trying to ride out this decisive day without choosing. The translation turns the mental loop into literal walking and narrows the evaded day to the night.
findings.japanese:
そうやって、いつまでも堂々巡りを繰り返し、
今日という日をやり過ごそうとしていた俺を…
findings.todokanai: As I was trying to pass the night walking around in circles as I was…

findings.highlight: The snow seeps through me.
findings.evidenceJa: 雪が、滲む
findings.explanation: The snow blurs in Haruki's vision as pain reaches the corners of his eyes. The translation treats 滲む as the snow physically seeping through him and loses the onset of tears.
findings.japanese: 雪が、滲む。
findings.todokanai: The snow seeps through me.

findings.highlight: assaults me from within
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の目頭までも襲ってきたから
findings.explanation: The pain attacks even the inner corners of Haruki's eyes, explaining why the snow blurs through tears. The translation omits the eyes and substitutes an unspecific internal assault.
findings.japanese:
体も心も掻き毟らんばかりの痛みが、
俺の目頭までも襲ってきたから。
findings.todokanai: A pain intense enough to tear off my heart and tear my body apart assaults me from within.
